content: ArgoCD (v3.4.4, Jun 2026) recommended over Flux (v2.9.0) for solo-dev homelab: built-in web UI for visibility/rollback, single opinionated install, out-of-box Helm/Kustomize/plain YAML, webhook-triggered instant sync vs Flux 5-min polling. Flux wins on footprint/modularity for large fleets, irrelevant at single-cluster scale.
